sourceControl: Non-Regular Sleep Styles > Show Last Roll Excl.
scope: RAE UI snapshot; not official confirmation; user approved full snapshot on 2026-10-14

tieBreakRule.basis: User-confirmed model: equal DPR prefers smaller SPO ID, then lower unlock rank, then smaller internal sleep-style ID. This precedence is not presented as officially confirmed game behavior.
tieBreakRule.spoIdSource: sleep-dpr-source.json entries[].spoId, projected into sleep-styles.json without changing DPR values

conflictingSource: https://wikiwiki.jp/poke_sleep/睡眠リサーチ/ねむけパワー/寝顔出現の法則
conflict: Wiki suggests other added Pokemon now enter the last-roll pool; current RAE explicitly marks many recent styles as excluded. Exact rare-entry probabilities are not established by the RAE UI.
implementedIntegration: Map the source internal IDs using sleepStyleInternalId, rather than generated per-island row IDs.
Filter excluded styles only from terminal maximum selection; retain ordinary-draw weights and existing exhausted-budget behavior.
Update both selectSleepStyle and createSleepSelector consistently.
Preserve exclusion eligibility in babyEfficiency grouping and bucket keys so excluded and eligible candidates cannot merge.
Use the same shared source for App and WeChat; do not change DPR, event weights or panel defaults.
terminalFallback: If no eligible terminal style is affordable, use the minimum-DPR eligible style with the SPO ID/rank/internal-ID tie order.
If no terminal-eligible style remains at all, return undefined and let the caller apply its existing fallback.
Old sleep and efficiency checkpoints are rejected with version 4 so pre-change results cannot be mixed into resumed simulations.
